title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 FEB)
summary: A monthly list of community ideas from February 2026 for improving Business Central, grouped by functional area. Areas include agents and Copilot, development, financial management, general usability, inventory, manufacturing, projects, purchasing, reporting, sales and tenant administration. Each idea is credited to its author.
key_points: Agent and Copilot ideas include sales-to-purchase traceability, clearer Copilot credit costs, faster Copilot chat and an extensible Sales Order Agent
Development ideas include multiselect on pages, report extension events, Shopify connector improvements, more public procedures and CSV Buffer fields longer than 250 characters
Finance ideas cover the German VAT ID validation interface, pausing subscription billing, foreign currency adjustments and bank reconciliation clarity
General ideas include auto refresh, Teams call pop-ups, page scripting translation fixes and showing recent pages in search
Tenant administration ideas focus on AppSource submission timeouts, per-country submissions, app bundles and better update information
features: Sales to Purchase traceability with Copilot

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a community-driven collection of feature improvement suggestions for Business Central
